Name: Project Rap
Overview:
Create a hilarious custom rap song, or battle a friend or AI for the best rhymes while throwing "Yo Mama" insults. Solo rappers may compete for global high scores.

All performances can be saved and replayed for a good laugh.

Choose a single word (from hundreds of available words) and the game will formulate a sentence around it, so boring grammar won’t stand in the way of your dope rhymes!
